# Evochem

> Evochem (Ennwin Industries Pvt Ltd, Anekal, Bengaluru) manufactures industrial and hygiene cleaning chemicals in India: food processing hygiene, commercial kitchen, housekeeping, commercial laundry, hand hygiene and industrial degreasing chemicals, supplied in bulk across India.

- [Home](https://evochem.co.in/)
- [Cleaning chemicals manufacturer in Bangalore](https://evochem.co.in/cleaning-chemicals-manufacturer-bangalore/)
- [Contact / get a quote](https://evochem.co.in/contactus/)
- [Sitemap](https://evochem.co.in/sitemap.xml)

## Product categories

- [Industrial hygiene](https://evochem.co.in/products/industrial-cleaning-degreasing-chemicals/): Industrial degreaser manufacturer in India: heavy-duty floor cleaner, low-foam oil and grease remover and workshop hand wash for factories and warehouses.
- [Laundry care](https://evochem.co.in/products/commercial-laundry-chemicals/): Commercial laundry chemicals from a laundry chemical supplier in India: pre-wash, main wash, builder, chlorine destainer, sour and softener for hotels.
- [Food processing hygiene](https://evochem.co.in/products/food-processing-hygiene-chemicals/): Food industry cleaning and sanitation chemicals: foam cleaners, low-foam CIP detergents and sanitisers for dairy, meat, poultry, beverage and food plants.
- [Personal care](https://evochem.co.in/products/professional-hand-hygiene-products/): Bulk handwash liquid supplier and hand sanitiser manufacturer in India: perfume-free, antibacterial, heavy-duty, foaming and luxury handwash and sanitiser.
- [Housekeeping](https://evochem.co.in/products/institutional-housekeeping-chemicals/): Commercial cleaning chemicals manufacturer for offices, hotels and hospitals: bathroom, toilet, glass, floor, furniture, steel, carpet and descaling products.
- [Commercial kitchen](https://evochem.co.in/products/commercial-kitchen-cleaning-chemicals/): Commercial kitchen cleaning chemicals from a restaurant cleaning chemicals supplier: dishwasher detergent, rinse aid, degreasers, oven cleaner and sanitisers.

## Industries

- [Food and beverage processing](https://evochem.co.in/industries/food-processing/): Food processing cleaning chemicals made in India: foam cleaners, CIP detergents and food-industry sanitisers for dairy, meat, poultry and beverage plants.
- [Dairy processing](https://evochem.co.in/industries/dairy-processing/): Dairy cleaning chemicals for milk plants: alkaline CIP detergents for tanks and pasteurisers, foam cleaners, sanitisers and handwash. Made in Bengaluru.
- [Poultry and meat processing](https://evochem.co.in/industries/poultry-meat-processing/): Poultry processing cleaning chemicals for meat plants: foam cleaners for fat and blood, chlorinated alkaline daily cleaning, sanitisers, drains and handwash.
